title: Own and drain native tasks independently of caller observation
scope: Native/Wasm cooperative task ownership and bounded wake queue over owned non-Send futures. Start admitted tasks eagerly, retain pending work without an observation ticket, drain in FIFO wake order with bounded turns, and accept cross-thread wakes without exposing document state to threads. This is a new Rust host mechanism, not a claimed port of a pinned source function.
acceptance: Meaningful native tests prove caller-ticket drop leaves late work running, synchronous first polling, FIFO/deduplicated/self/cross-thread wake behavior, reentrant task submission, completed-slot reuse with stale wakers, admission/depth/turn bounds and explicit non-idle finish refusal.
Full fast/native/Wasm gates pass; source deadline/guarded integration and end-to-end original comparisons remain explicit continuations, with verification none until actual paired runtime evidence.
symbols: Native runtime continuation for limited/execute body ownership (new host code)
open_items: Implement the bounded owner; then wire real deadline/history/guarded/interrupt futures and late effects. No paired runtime or browser execution claim.
